#726 · Fire Cat Pokémon

Torracat

Fire

Alola · Generation 7

Torracat is a Fire-type Fire Cat Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 25 kg. It evolves from Litten and into Incineroar. Its highest base stat is Speed (90), with a base stat total of 420.
